facts.text: Mayville State University is recognized as the nation's first tablet PC campus.

sources.title: Spring Enrollment hits another record high - Mayville State University
sources.quote: Mayville State University, the nation's first tablet PC campus, is a personable rural campus.

facts.text: Through its Dual Credit Scholarship Program, students who completed at least one Mayville State dual credit course in high school earn a freshman tuition waiver equivalent to the cost of their dual credit tuition up to $2,000.

sources.title: Early Entry (Dual Credit) :: Mayville State University :: Mayville, ND
sources.quote: Students will earn a waiver equivalent to the cost of their dual credit tuition for their freshman year at Mayville State. The scholarship will not exceed the amount of $2000.
